  4. Shocked But Not Awed: Manipulation and Counter-Manipulation in the 2024 Pakistan Elections
    Hassan Mahmood, Syed Taha Ali · pp. 1-20 · online 2026-10-25
    摘要

    This paper attempts to increase our understanding of the micro-dynamics of the election rigging process in hybrid regimes by presenting a detailed case study of the 2024 general elections in Pakistan. It focuses not only on the ‘menu of manipulation’ employed by the Pakistani military and its collaborators, but the manner in which these interventions were combined and sequenced to yield what initially appeared to be a coherent and effective ‘shock and awe’ strategy, designed to completely beat the out-of-favour Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf and its supporters into submission even before the polls began. It describes the reasons why this strategy failed, including the clever use of technology by PTI supporters and the excessive harshness displayed by the military, which hurt rather than helped its cause, forcing it to take ‘corrective’ actions that not only undermined the legitimacy of the poll but the popularity of the military and its collaborators as well.

  5. In Murky Waters: Insights on Doing Feminist Research as Men in India
    Prakash Khundrakpam, Jayanta Krishna Sarmah · pp. 1-17 · online 2026-10-20
    摘要

    Recent feminist scholarship argues that men can and should conduct feminist research, guided by critical epistemological and political principles. Such participation is valued for producing knowledge grounded in strong objectivity in incorporating the male standpoint as another lens, while also enabling men to acknowledge the historico-moral responsibility tied to their gendered position, thereby becoming co-companions in knowledge production and feminist emancipation. In this context, drawing on ethnographic fieldwork in India and collective auto-ethnographic reflection, this article offers three insights. First, men’s resolve to engage in feminist research emerges when ingrained patriarchal mindsets are unsettled by education and, crucially, by lived interactions with women research subjects. Second, we examine the ethical dilemmas in such research, particularly access negotiated through a female associate, which raises questions of agency and epistemological ownership. Finally, we suggest strategies for disseminating findings beyond the field to further the feminist project.

  6. Populist Politics and Law Reform in Sri Lanka: Whither Legal Pluralism?
    Sepalika Welikala · pp. 1-19 · online 2026-10-13
    摘要

    This paper explores the complex interplay between Right-wing populism and law reform, and its impact on legal pluralism, analysed through the ‘One Country, One Law’ (OCOL) law reform campaign in Sri Lanka. Focusing on legal processes as embedded within socio-cultural and political contexts, and understanding law reform as a site where political ideology is articulated and mobilised to advance populist politics, this discussion examines the Right-wing legal mobilisation through the OCOL campaign, which challenges not just Muslim personal law but also the plural legal system of Sri Lanka. Although the reform campaign was abandoned, this paper demonstrates that the reform process was appropriated by Right-wing populist actors to promote a single unified legal system in line with the majoritarian political ideology and the marginalisation of minority communities. Such politicisation has a profound impact on society, particularly one that values diversity and pluralism.

  7. Beneath Khangchendzonga’s Shadow: Division, Belonging and Multiplicity in Lepcha Healing Traditions
    Melissa Zermit Namchu · pp. 1-16 · online 2026-10-05
    摘要

    This article examines indigenous Lepcha health practices within the historical and socio-political context of Máyel Lyáng. Critiquing the paucity of historical sources, it explores how colonialism, missionary encounters and Tibetanisation reshaped Lepcha healing traditions within the sacred and geographical landscape of Máyel Lyáng in the Eastern Himalayan region. These interventions not only altered the territorial integrity but also the epistemological foundations of traditional Lepcha healing, producing a diverse therapeutic field comprising ritual healers, herbalists, Buddhist monks, healers who integrate Christian prayers, bonesetters, and practitioners incorporating biomedical diagnostics. Drawing on methodological triangulation through historical sources, secondary literature and ethnographic data from Máyel Lyáng, this study situates Lepcha healing within broader regional dynamics shaped by Buddhist, Christian and biomedical influences. It argues that Lepcha healing traditions remain dynamic sites of negotiation, where resilience and adaptation sustain diverse therapeutic practices, contributing to anthropological debates on health, religion and cultural transformation in South Asia.

  8. A New Legal Order for India’s New Woman: Interrogating the Spectacle of Emancipation in Contemporary Courtroom Dramas of Consent
    Amalie Goul Dueholm · pp. 1-22 · online 2026-10-05
    摘要

    In the latter half of the 2010s, some Hindi courtroom dramas invoked the concept of ‘consent’ to adjudicate sexual violence cases. In these films, consent functions as a tool that ensures that the judiciary no longer relies on moralising judgements about women’s sexual history or their public behaviour to reach its verdicts. This paper draws on close analysis of two Hindi films, Pink and Section 375, to examine this emancipatory promise. By attending to the films’ framing of rape as a legal mystery that can be factually established, the paper asks how the rhetoric of consent shapes what gets recognised as sexual violence, and it draws on feminist legal scholarship to argue that while consent facilitates a powerful spectacle of a new legal order committed to gender justice on screen, it also demonstrates how legal fetishism risks disciplining female desire while foreclosing other possibilities for imagining justice.

  9. Virahi -Masculinity and the (Dis)Contents in Nation-Making: Devdas in Early Twentieth Century India
    Oindri Roy · pp. 1-22 · online 2026-09-29
    摘要

    The article unravels the interplay of viraha, masculinity and early twentieth century nationhood in India through Saratchandra’s Devdas (1917) and Pramathesh Barua’s Hindi Devdas (1936). The representations of male desire, situated in the liminal space of personal and political, foster the close, historicised readings of the texts. This provides the scope to examine the multifarious impingements of nationhood, often India’s pro-Hindu nation-making, in the formation and stylisation of viraha and virahi. The Hindu familial space, the vaishanava and the Islamicate registers of viraha and the virahi’s alcoholism are key points of inquiry in this study on Devdas. The spectre(s) of death in both novel and film also entail critical inquiry. As such, a heterogeneous framework of cultural and social histories helps construe the impact of this long-loved, long-yearning hero on the critical idiom of viraha and nation-making, or, rather, virahi (man-in-yearning), in the project of early twentieth century Indian nationhood.

  10. Mahadevi’s Viraha : Gender, Longing and the Nation
    Vandana Saxena · pp. 1-19 · online 2026-09-22
    摘要

    This paper explores the theme of viraha and the persona of the virahini in the writings of Mahadevi Varma, a prominent Hindi woman writer of the mid twentieth century. Varma’s poetry focuses on the persona of a virahini—a woman in love, solitary and ready to surrender herself to the intensity of her feelings for her lover. This emotional matrix has earned her the epithet of the ‘modern Mira’. A careful exploration of the indomitable self of Varma’s virahini not only marks her difference from the virahini of the Bhakti poets but also places the persona in the historical moment of India’s anti-colonial struggle, particularly Gandhian nationalism. This connects to Varma’s prose writings, which reflect upon various forms of longing and pain, focusing especially on feminine subjects in a colonised and patriarchal society. Here she records the stories of virahinis around her—the widows, child brides and abandoned women. In her essays and editorials, this pain and longing are transformed into logical and succinct arguments in favour of women and the need for social reform as a part of the movement for freedom. The article ends with deliberations on the persistent strains of viraha in Varma’s writing as the discourse of women and social reform is circumscribed by the benign paternalism of Gandhian thought that celebrates and limits the feminine subject within the folds of domesticity and tradition—the very limits that Varma’s virahini longs to overcome.

  11. The Romantic Nationalist: Aesthetics of Viraha in the Poetry of Ambikagiri Raichoudhury
    Dhurjjati Sarma · pp. 1-18 · online 2026-09-22
    摘要

    The early decades of the twentieth century signified a dual engagement within many Indian poets with the romantic-modernist influence acquired from the West on the one hand, and the patriotic and nationalist sentiments of the anti-colonial freedom struggle on the other. This paper will look into the poetry of Ambikagiri Raichoudhury, published in various collections like Tumi (1915), Beena (1916), Anubhuti (1954) and Bedonar Ulka (1964), in which he skilfully conflates his desire for freedom and liberty with an intimate appreciation of both sambhoga and viyoga as affective principles, enabling him to cultivate an in-depth and integrative spiritual-devotional sensibility. The paper aims to critically engage with this integrative impulse evident in selected poems of Raichoudhury, which reflect a modern refashioning of viraha a mystic–spiritual experience manifested in verses addressed to the beloved yet having deeper implications with the many-layered dynamics of identity and patriotism.

  12. The Re-Invention of the Virahiṇī : Image-Making of a De-Eroticised Nāyikā in Bengal Nationalism
    Gunjan · pp. 1-27 · online 2026-09-16
    摘要

    This paper examines the reconfiguration of the sensuous and spiritually charged image of the virahiṇī, tracing her transformation from early modern paintings of Rajasthan and the Pahari states to a morally idealised and hybridised figure painted by the artists of the Bengal School in the late nineteenth and early twentieth century. It begins with the visualisation of viraha (separation) experienced by the nāyikā (heroine) in early modern paintings based on texts such as Bhāgavata Purāṇa and Rasamañjarī, where separation is articulated as both an emotional and spiritual surrender. The essay further traces how the artists of Bengal School re-imagined the figure of virahiṇī by tempering her sensuality to present an austere and self-sacrificial figure who appealed to the nationalist ethos of colonial India striving for independence.

  13. Yearning and Its Limits: Viraha and the Gendered Script of Desire in Haryanvi Saang
    Suman Sigroha, Muskan Dhandhi · pp. 1-20 · online 2026-09-06
    摘要

    Saang/Swaang/Suaang or folk drama in Haryana, a state in North India, has been one of the most important forms of entertainment since the eighteenth century. This lesser-known and relatively understudied performative folk tradition comprises music, dance and drama, and its varied content is based on myths, legends and subjects of socio-cultural significance. The author-composer can narrate and simultaneously perform, and in the process enables the intervention and interplay of the socio-cultural landscape. This paper focuses on the textual analysis of two Saangs by Pandit Lakhmi Chand to examine how the male-authored and male-performed traditions project masculine anxieties through stylised depictions of female desire, betrayal and emotional excess. By tracing viraha within these folk performances, the paper highlights how male suffering becomes a cautionary tale that reinforces gender hierarchies and reasserts patriarchal control in the face of perceived feminine transgression.

  14. Controlling Multiplicity: Hindu Mythologies in the Works of Amish Tripathi and Devdutt Pattanaik
    Uttara Rangarajan · pp. 1-22 · online 2026-09-06
    摘要

    This essay examines the emerging genre of mythological fiction through the works of two popular Indian authors, Amish Tripathi and Devdutt Pattanaik. Combining Hindu mythology with global speculative genres, mythological fiction instantiates new discursive spaces for the negotiation of Hindu identity and nationalism. Reading Tripathi’s Shiva Trilogy and Pattanaik’s Jaya and Sita, this essay argues that despite producing works that are formally and ideologically distinct, both authors position themselves as interlocutors who interpret Hinduism for common, middle-class citizens. Drawing on genre theory, studies of the Indian English novel and research on Hindu mythology, this essay suggests that Tripathi and Pattanaik draw on a combination of local and global modes to restrict the multiplicity and heterogeneity of the Hindu narrative tradition. Though they are located at different ends of the Hindu nationalist spectrum, both authors help English-speaking, upwardly mobile Indians to navigate their public identities as Hindus in an increasingly ethnocentric nation.

  15. Songs of Separation in Bangladesh: Viraha , Affect and Anti-Colonial Imaginings in Early Twentieth Century Baul Literature and Folk Creative Industries
    Golam Rabbani · pp. 1-21 · online 2026-09-02
    摘要

    This article examines how early twentieth century Baul songs from regions of Bengal now in Bangladesh reworked the classical Indic concept of viraha—the pain of separation—into an affective force moving across devotional expression, folk creative industries and emergent nationalist feelings. Drawing on painted poter gān scrolls, chapbooks, posters, Narayanganj shellac recordings and playbills from Kushtia and Dhaka, it traces the circulation of lyrics by Lalon Shah, Panju Shah and Gagan Harkara through river markets, village akhras and recording studios. In these circuits, longing for the maner mānuṣ (‘person of the heart’) acquired new semantic layers and, in some settings, became available as a figure for collective dispossession under colonial rule. Combining rasa aesthetics with the notions of affect, the article argues that Baul viraha did not simply mirror politics: through performance and circulation, it helped mediate between interior longing, social critique and forms of anti-colonial historical consciousness.

  16. Between the State and Market: Subaltern Resilience in Entrepreneurship
    Avienaash E. Poovaragavan · pp. 1-14 · online 2026-08-30
    摘要

    While state support for marginalised entrepreneurship rests on its presumed emancipatory potential, little attention is paid to the exclusionary practices reproduced through state and market agents. Drawing on an ethnographic study of the Dalit entrepreneurial ecosystem in Tamil Nadu, I demonstrate that market spaces are embedded within social hierarchies, where social logics shape both opportunities and motivations. Therefore, as the state expands market access for the marginalised, it simultaneously disciplines and reinscribes practices of caste through bureaucratic language and processes. The study reveals that despite neoliberal promises of equality through market participation, caste hierarchies continue to shape outcomes, preventing a neutral market space where the language of market and governance acts as a new means of articulating privilege.

  17. The Political Economy of the Rise and Fall of Brassware: A Case Study of Gadaladeniya, Sri Lanka
    Hasini Lecamwasam · pp. 1-18 · online 2026-08-30
    摘要

    Through the case of brassware producers in Gadaladeniya, Sri Lanka, I show that nationalism is not a tide that lifts all boats equally, even when some boats are supposed to be lifted so. Building upon qualitative fieldwork carried out intermittently from February to December 2023, I argue, first, that the complex effects of democratisation may have non-linear offshoots such as the disintegration of a traditionally marginalised caste community, rather than its empowerment; second, the social bases of state power may result in a single institutional apparatus yielding different benefits to different constituencies, depending on where the regime draws its electoral strength from, leading to fluctuations in community fortunes; and third, and last, customised methods of production that both enable traditional crafts to have a distinct presence in the market while also constraining their productive capacities further contribute to their unviability, compounding disintegrative tendencies.

  18. Echoes of Displacement: Women’s Voices of Longing, Identity and Belonging in Pashto Tappay
    Saeeda Khan · pp. 1-20 · online 2026-08-19
    摘要

    This study examines Pashto tappay as a vernacular expression of displacement, longing and identity among Pashtun women in exile. Tappay are explored as affective and political forms that register suffering, endurance and the desire for belonging in unfamiliar or hostile settings. Framed through viraha and Das’ theory of everyday violence, the study interprets tappay as intimate sites where separation, memory and structural rupture converge. Fifty tappay were collected from oral sources and literature, alongside insights from two cultural experts. Using thematic analysis and feminist discourse analysis, the study identifies themes of longing for homeland, critiques of gendered oppression, and spiritual metaphors. Findings reveal tappay as a restrained yet powerful mode of feminist expression through which women voice pain, preserve identity and challenge patriarchal and militarised structures. The study contributes to debates on subaltern voices, vernacular knowledge and feminine resistance in exile and conflict zones, challenging portrayals of Pashtun women as passive victims.

  19. Transcending Viraha in Malaysia: From Bharatanatyam Aesthetics to Diasporic Longing
    Premalatha Thiagarajan · pp. 1-20 · online 2026-08-13
    摘要

    In Bharatanatyam recitals, the dancer takes on the central role of nayika (heroine), who pines and longs to be united with her nayaka (the Supreme Lord, who is usually God). In the end, whether she unites with her Lord or not is secondary, but the narrative highlights a spectrum of separation and longing (viraha). This paper brings to the fore a Malaysian Bharatanatyam performance, Saayujya… An Eternity of Longing, presented by a leading dance exponent, Ajith Bhaskar, to discuss the portrayal of the nayika and her viraha in the performance, but here, it is done purposefully to interrogate the ambiguous relationship between the Indian-Malaysian diaspora (the metaphorical nayika) and its homeland, India (the metaphorical nayaka). This paper explores the ‘home-diaspora’ connection through a historical and ethnographic writing, examining how Bharatanatyam emerged through the longing amongst Indian-Malaysians and the subsequent emergence of self-sustaining practices of Bharatanatyam in Malaysia.

  20. Beyond Uniformity: Bodily Gestures and the Resisting Gaze of Nachni s in Purulia
    Sudatta Ghosh · pp. 1-18 · online 2026-08-10
    摘要

    This paper critically examines the gestures and gaze used by nachnis to resist stigma and dominant regimes of uniformity. Critical dance scholarship has highlighted how bodies are scripted through distinctive movements and why dancing bodies must be understood beyond the classical-folk binary. Drawing on cultural labour as an analytical framework, I show how performance and performer mutually shape one another through controlled gaze and sensuality, challenging the disciplinary regimes of caste, gender and sexuality that structure dance practices. The bodily gestures of dancing bodies, such as nachnis, question codified understandings of dance and exceed ideals of uniformity. This performance tradition emerges as an improvised practice deeply embedded in caste and gender relations. The nachni’s sensuous movements sustain livelihood, negotiate stigma, engage with the male gaze and resist through a controlled gaze. Through the case of the nachni, I reconceptualise bodily gestures as a site of labour and embodied resistance.

  21. The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh’s ‘Struggle’ for Democracy: Hindu Nationalism, Propaganda and the Internal Emergency of India
    Neha Chaudhary · pp. 1-22 · online 2026-07-26
    摘要

    Through an analysis of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh’s (RSS’) propaganda literature, this article examines how the RSS transformed a moment of political crisis into a foundational episode to legitimise its brand of organisational and ideological politics. Central to the Sangh’s retelling of the Emergency ‘history’ were two narratives: first, the cultivation of symbolic capital by publicising endorsement for the Sangh from Jayaprakash Narayan; second, the production of a narrative counter to the public and academic history of the resistance against the Emergency to frame the RSS and its members as the principal defenders of democratic freedoms and constitutional values. This article argues that the RSS used propaganda as memory-making in the aftermath of the Emergency to refashion its public image, reposition its ideological commitments and enter the arena of high politics with a legitimacy it had never had before.

  23. A ‘Swadeshi’ Star Is Born: Locating Visions of Nationalist and Consumerist Utopias in Bal Gandharva’s Acts of Female Impersonation
    Radhika Raghav · pp. 1-27 · online 2026-07-21
    摘要

    This article examines the star text of Bal Gandharva (1888–1967), the celebrated female impersonator of Marathi sangeet natak (musical theatre), as a critical site for the production and commodification of respectable Hindu femininity in colonial India. Through close readings of two iconic roles—Shakuntala in Sangeet Shakuntal and Sindhu in Ekach Pyala—it demonstrates how Gandharva’s performances advanced the tenets of stridharma as the foundational moral grammar of respectable middle-class femininity. It further discusses how his theatrical embodiment extended into the marketplace through ‘Gandharva Fashion’, ultimately consolidating the archetype of the sugrahini (the idealised housewife) as a citizen-consumer. Drawing on theatre stills, promotional imagery, advertisements and periodicals, the article repositions Gandharva as modern India’s first swadeshi star, whose performances offered visions of nationalist and consumerist utopias by marketing femininity as both moral virtue and consumable spectacle.

Twentieth-Century China

  6. Language as Movement: A Short History of the Cantophone, 1840s–1920s
    Laikwan Pang · pp. 262-283
    摘要

    This article explores how Cantonese speakers in the late Qing and early Republican periods traveled and connected with the world. It is a social and cultural study of the journeys and transformation of Cantonese, both as a people and as a language, in a new geopolitical and technological environment consisting of Western imperialism, Chinese nationalism, and individuals’ enterprising efforts. I study how Cantonese reached Shanghai and Guangxi within China to interact with the languages and people in those places, and I also explore how it crossed the South Sea to British Malaya and the Pacific to Hawaii and the United States. I then follow the trajectories of study abroad students in Japan to witness how Cantonese left China and came back and in what ways the language participated in some of the most important political events of the time. This historical account offers an alternative view to understanding the life of a language, which in turn can help us understand the complex dynamics of language, power, and identity.

  7. Fluvial Dreams of Modernity: Hydropower Infrastructure, Global Networks, and State Making in Xikang, 1939–1947
    Zachary A. Clark · pp. 284-305
    摘要

    When China’s Republican government fled to Chongqing during the Second Sino-Japanese War (1937–1945), it brought with it a heightened demand for electricity production for the war effort. The relocation of the Nationalist government and an ambitious new generation of Chinese technocrats to Sichuan Province brought unprecedented resources to West China. After Xikang Province was formally established in 1939, the provincial government under Liu Wenhui acted as a key intermediary that connected the central government’s desire for wartime resources with Xikang elites and officials’ interest in local energy development projects. This new alignment of interests allowed the Xikang provincial government to secure the technical expertise, finances, and equipment necessary to build two state-of-the-art hydropower dams during the wartime period. The legacies of these projects and the engineering experts who worked on them were foundational to the earliest imaginings of the vast scale and potential of hydroelectricity in the Sino-Tibetan borderland.

  8. Transnational Gold Smuggling and the Making of Hong Kong’s Financial Hub, 1944–1973
    Ka Shing So · pp. 306-324
    摘要

    This article reinterprets Hong Kong’s postwar ascent by placing gold smuggling at the heart of its political economy. Challenging the narratives that credit only formal financial institutions, it shows how unregulated gold flows supplied the liquidity that propelled the colony from an entrepôt to a regional financial hub. Drawing on 1944–1968 court transcripts, police files, colonial correspondence, and newspapers, the study reconstructs the transnational corridors that ferried gold from Australia, Southeast Asia, and South Asia through Hong Kong to high-premium destinations such as Singapore and Calcutta. The Hong Kong colonial authorities’ policy of calculated underenforcement effectively transformed bullion into a stateless reserve asset. These shadow credit pools broadened Hong Kong’s foreign-exchange expertise and reshaped its postwar political economy. By foregrounding the networks that made this possible, the article offers a bottom-up perspective on state power, legality, and financial agency in Cold War Hong Kong.

  9. In Search of Utopia: The Intellectual Transformation of Xu Liangying from Loyal Communist to Democracy Advocate from the 1930s to 2013
    Verna Yu · pp. 325-344
    摘要

    This article examines the life of Xu Liangying (1920–2013) as a case study for understanding the transformation of his generation, members of which pursued a romantic “national salvation” goal through the Communist utopian vision but later became advocates of liberal democracy. On the basis of Xu’s personal writings and interviews, this article argues that his subjectivity prompted two intellectual transformations, first from May Fourth–inspired liberal idealism to Marxism-Leninism before 1949 and then to liberal democracy in the post-Mao era. The article concludes that (1) Xu’s case demonstrates that power and ideology are not merely imposed but involve internalization of regime values, (2) Xu’s early liberal resources enabled him to reconstruct his identity and repudiate Communist values in the post-Mao era, and (3) passion and idealism, not strategic calculations, characterized the generation who matured during wartime in the 1930s and 1940s. This article highlights twentieth-century Chinese intellectuals’ inner struggles and subjectivity in reconstructing their identities for personal and national salvation.

    Ding-Liang Chen · pp. 120-147
    摘要

    What if the history of digitality began in landscapes instead of laboratories? This essay proposes the geology of grids as a method for tracing the entanglement of empire and ecology in Southeast Asia as the infrastructure of global connectivity. Centering on the region's first fiber-optic cable, I examine how Rithy Panh's documentary The Land of the Wandering Souls evokes elemental thinking of media infrastructure beyond Western epistemologies. Exhuming buried remains of war and genocide, the grounding of cable grids not only epitomizes racial capitalism of digital modernity but evinces the earth as a contested archive of ghostly matters. I argue that these geologic intimacies expressed through Cambodian cosmologies and ontologies enable a decolonial lens for conceptualizing critical information studies in Global Asias.

  7. Endgame Taiwan: KMT's Civil Defense Media and the Emergence of a Cybernetic Aesthetic
    Lawrence Zi-Qiao Yang · pp. 148-178
    摘要

    This article examines the civil defense media apparatus of the Kuomintang (KMT) regime in Taiwan between the 1950s and 1970s, arguing that these media gave rise to a distinctive organizational and aesthetic form I call a cybernetic aesthetic. I trace three registers of this formation: the reactivation of wartime memory in China as mnemonic data; the spread of American operation research and scientific management as an aesthetics of informatization; and the production of a specific mode of enclosure and captivation that trained technocratic cadres and civilian populations to perceive themselves as nodes within a distributed system of signal, noise, and feedback. I situate this formation within Cold War cybernetic thought to show how military-defense aesthetics enclosed social and organizational life in Cold War Taiwan.

  8. Unsettling the Settlement of Land: The Use of Compensation in Base Perimeter Space
    Tony Hyunduck Cho · pp. 179-203
    摘要

    By approaching compensation not only as a mode of redress but as a computational practice, this article highlights how land disputes between South Korean residents and US military bases are settled through the South Korean state's calculation of land and environment. Drawing from archival research and ethnographic fieldwork in Pyeongtaek, this essay traces the emergence of compensation protocols under the Special Act of Support for Pyeongtaek. The article examines how the bill was used to establish the US military base expansion in the city in exchange for redeveloping Pyeongtaek into an industrial city. Furthermore, the use of compensation shows how redress is performed in order to justify dispossession and the latent harms caused by everyday base activity.

  9. Searching for My Father's House: Gaze-Scaling the Philippines and Mars Across the (Digital) Diaspora
    Maya Cruz · pp. 204-222
    摘要

    How do new computational visions of universalized planetary environments shape life across the Philippine diaspora? I take up this question through my own experience of what I term "gaze-scaling in the digital diaspora," a computational practice which I situate within the history of the development of network computing and the production of networked planetary environments, arguing that gaze-scaling produces new modes of the scientific subject, both the universalized unmarked observer, and the diasporic subjectivity it disavows.

  10. Platform Islandization: The Making of the Computational Archipelago
    Merlyna Lim · pp. 223-247
    摘要

    This essay introduces platform islandization to theorize digital life beyond questions of infrastructure or access, through situated rhythms and ruptures that challenge the universalist claims of platform logics. Platform islandization is a socio-technical process in which bounded and selectively connected publics emerge within platformed environments. This process produces computational archipelagos : fragmented configurations of visibility, access, and affect structured by platform logics and infrastructures. I articulate platform islandization across three registers— infrastructural-experiential, epistemic-ethical, and aesthetic-algorithmic —revealing fragmentation as a patterned condition rather than a deficit. Grounded in long-term research in Indonesia, this framework invokes "Indonesia as method" and offers a portable analytic for understanding how people and digital systems mutually reorder publics, emotions, and knowledges across diverse contexts.

中央研究院歷史語言研究所集刊

Vol. 97, No. 2 · 2026-06 · 3 篇 · 中央研究院歷史語言研究所 · 中國史、語言、考古 · Peer-reviewed
  1. 西周時期葬馬禮俗新識：姚河塬遺址二號車馬坑葬馬研究 / New Insights into the Rituals and Customs of Horse Interment during the Western Zhou Period: Horse Remains from Chariot-Horse Pit No. 2 at Yaoheyuan
    李悅, 馬強, 吳禕, 張成睿, 羅丰 · pp. 195-252
    摘要

    馬（Equus caballus）在中國古代政治、經濟、文化景觀的塑造與演變過程中扮演重要角色。西周時期，馬不僅是生業經濟與軍事活動的關鍵資源，也是貴族階層喪葬與祭祀的重要元素。墓外祔葬的車馬坑和馬坑是西周時期馬匹儀式性使用的主要表現形式。以往關於西周時期車馬埋葬的研究多集中於車、馬組合形式及其反映的社會等級等問題，而針對馬骨本身的系統研究仍然較為缺乏。尤其是關於車馬埋葬的具體過程以及車馬坑葬馬選擇等問題，相關研究尚屬空白。 本文基於對寧夏彭陽姚河塬西周遺址二號車馬坑葬馬的現場提取和系統整理分析，嘗試復原車馬的埋葬過程，揭示馬匹的生物性狀。在此基礎上，結合已發表材料，探討西周時期車馬坑和馬坑葬馬的選擇特點。 姚河塬遺址是中國西北地區首次發現的西周時期封國都邑城址。二號車馬坑位於遺址高等級墓葬區的東側邊緣，是已發掘車馬坑中埋葬車輛和馬匹數量均最多的一座。現場提取和整理工作表明，二號車馬坑內共葬有拆卸後的車輛3乘和至少28匹馬（另有1具死後分娩的胎兒，僅存少量骨骼）。對馬匹疊壓關係的梳理和分析顯示，這些馬匹的擺放並非隨意無序。車馬坑東部、南部、西部緊貼坑底的馬匹應是最早被葬入的個體；之後在其上方沿不同方向陸續葬入更多馬匹；最後在車馬坑東北角集中葬入剩餘馬匹。這些馬匹未見掙扎痕跡和四肢捆綁跡象，且均無骨折現象，因此很可能是在坑外被殺死後由葬儀人員借助工具葬入坑內。此外，馬匹死後分娩的現象暗示二號車馬坑的填埋可能發生在春夏之際。 二號車馬坑可判斷性別的葬馬中僅1具為雌性，其餘均為雄性。馬匹的年齡跨度相對較大，雖然已成年個體數量最多，但仍包含部分未成年與老年個體，整體上可能象徵了一個小型馬群。牙齒與骨骼上的異常現象表明，部分馬匹生前可能受到不同程度的役使。總體而言，二號車馬坑的葬馬以服役能力較強、體型較為高大的雄性青壯年個體為主。與其他幾處西周時期馬坑的比較分析進一步顯示，葬馬的年齡、身高等生物性狀的選擇可能與馬坑、車馬坑對應墓葬和墓地的等級關係密切。 本研究是對西周時期車馬埋葬過程的首次探討，也是針對西周時期車馬坑、馬坑葬馬選擇特點的綜合考察。本文希望通過姚河塬遺址二號車馬坑的個案分析拓寬研究思路，為更全面、深入地認識中國古代車馬埋葬制度提供新的視角。

  2. 木材水運與始皇「興事」——放馬灘秦墓木板地圖補釋 / Timber Transport by Water and the Construction Projects of Emperor Qin Shi Huang: The Wooden Board Maps from the Qin Tomb at Fangmatan
    王澤 · pp. 253-320
    摘要

    放馬灘秦墓出土的木板地圖，可從林區水運的思路深入考察。通過木板地圖的水系支流與今水系的對應，可以明確文字注記的位置。地圖的讀圖順序為內容較舊的1-2-3-4-5；內容較新的7-6。這組地圖體現了秦人伐木的南進歷程：上溯東柯河、越過分水嶺、南下花廟河。放馬灘是分水嶺之上的轉運樞紐，墓主是在此管理木材水陸轉運的官吏。秦統一後大興土木、木材供應網路擴大，木板地圖上的伐木南進、水陸轉運，都是因此而起。運輸業的旺盛需求，使得秦朝的水運勃興。放馬灘地圖所見水陸轉運，發展為秦始皇晚年的「寫蜀、荊地材皆至」。秦的水運優勢不加節制地擴展，導致運輸規模超前、資源汲取過量，埋下了「天下始畔秦」的禍根。

  3. 平田篤胤的「古學」與諸子學、緯書、道教——宇宙、古史、地理的想像與書寫 / Hirata Atsutane’s“Ancient Learning”and Its Relations to the Hundred Schools, Weft Texts, and Taoism: Imagination and Writing of the Cosmos, Ancient History, and World Geography
    藍弘岳 (Hung-yueh Lan) · pp. 321-384
    摘要

    儘管平田篤胤被稱為國學者，其學也是一種「古學」。其主要內容與方法是在宣長學基礎上發展而來的，但後來篤胤發展出與宣長不同的神學。這主要是因為篤胤不僅閱讀大量儒學、道教相關典籍，更將諸子學、緯書、道家、中醫、基督教相關書籍乃至佛學典籍和蘭學知識等納入其知識體系中，以論證一個日本諸神所建構的世界。但本文特別關注平田篤胤思想與道教，及構成道教思想資源的諸子學和緯書等書中之上古中國歷史和地理想像、宇宙論說間之關聯。本文將先分析篤胤在《靈能真柱》等前中期著作與宣長國學系統相關的宇宙論、古史認識等問題。然後，在東亞歷史與知識脈絡中，以《老子》《枕中書》《老子中經》等道教相關文獻為主，探析道教思想中，以「太一」為首和以「盤古」為首的兩種宇宙生成論。之後，本文再以《赤縣太古傳》等後期文本為主，探究篤胤如何以諸子學、緯書等與道教相關的漢籍知識為媒介，將道教的宇宙生成論導入其對宇宙和古史的書寫和想像之中，從而建構出不同於道教，也不同於宣長國學的宇宙論、古史書寫。其次，因為道教諸神的誕生與活動和中國的地景結構緊密地結合在一起，故本文也分析篤胤為合理化其論述，而如何重新解釋緯書和道教相關文本中固有的世界地理想像和空間思維，並建構出日本中心的世界地理想像。從而，本文將對篤胤何以受到道教相關知識吸引，及道教對其思想體系的建構有何貢獻提出一種解釋，並主張從東亞思想史視野探究篤胤思想的必要性。

中央研究院近代史研究所集刊

No. 132 · 2026-06 · 5 篇 · 中央研究院近代史研究所 · 中國近現代史 · Peer-reviewed
  1. 乾隆朝《職貢圖》的西域成員構成與西征準噶爾後的西域表述 / The Composition of Western Regional Entries in the Qianlong Court’s Illustrations of Tributary Peoples and the Representation of the Western Regions after the Conquest of the Dzungars
    林士鉉 · pp. 1-61
    摘要

    本文以乾隆朝《職貢圖》卷一為核心，考察其中西域成員的構成與排序，尤其關注伊犁厄魯特群組與回部諸城的關鍵地位，並探討原應歸入八旗、藩部而非傳統職貢範圍的成員如何被納入職貢圖像體系。研究結合《職貢圖》、《平定西域獻俘禮圖》、《萬國來朝圖》與乾隆年間所修《大清一統志》、《御製增訂清文鑑．旗分佐領類》及相關西域輿圖、滿文文獻等材料，透過圖像與文字的對讀，追索西域戰爭後清廷在知識編纂與疆域整合上的操作。本文指出，《職貢圖》卷一所呈現的伊犁厄魯特與回部各城，實際上被收錄於《御製增訂清文鑑》中，成為「平定準噶爾厄魯特」、「平定回子」等條目，顯示其身分已從外國、朝貢國改列為帝國旗屬、藩部，然而在視覺文本的編排上，卻仍被刻意安置於職貢序列之中。這種「越界」編排，使《職貢圖》既延續職貢圖像傳統，又成為書寫平定準噶爾與整併西域的重要歷史文本，標誌清帝國的「西域∕內亞轉向」。透過放大伊犁群組與西域諸城在圖像中的分量，準噶爾汗國作為獨立政權與歷史主體被抹消，只能以被內化的旗分與藩部之姿，納入「中國」疆域與帝國記憶之中。

  2. 官利和折舊：從上海機器織布局的公開募股資訊揭露看一些商業史問題 / Interest on Capital and Depreciation: The Shanghai Mechanical Textile Bureau’s Public Offering Information Disclosure in 1880
    鄧克騰 · pp. 63-101
    摘要

    本文將回顧上海機器織布局在1880年刊發的招商章程內容。以鄭觀應為首的原織布局管理層雖然欠缺誠信，在其披露的募股集資訊息中，仍然展示了中國首批本土股份公司許多少為人留意的方面。當時的官督商辦企業公開募股已透過報章刊行招商章程進行宣傳，並利用華僑國際網絡吸收海外資金。其招商章程所披露的資訊量相當多，不比同期外國上市公司遜色。除了介紹商業前景與其所享專利等法律背景外，更提供了盈利預測，並將資金用途、營收以及生產所涉直接、間接成本項目列出，並加以說明。為了吸引投資者，除了承諾派發官利外，公司更公告將會引入外國的提撥折舊、公舉董事、為企業資產購置保險等安排，間接地介紹了一些當時股份公司的最佳實踐。本文同時對學界仍欠清晰了解的官利制度、中國舊式會計制度未見提撥折舊等兩個近代商業史問題作出探討。官利按股東已投入資本額派發固定利息的分配安排，亦普遍見於當時的外國合夥商號和股份公司，並非中國獨有。其次是折舊。織布局聲明會引入外國企業機器設備攤扣折舊會計政策，證明了部分學者提出十九世紀歐美會計制度發展對中國並無影響之說並不正確。其實同一時期的另一家股份公司招商局，已見有提撥折舊。然而，由於擔心影響業績及派息關係，這一做法在當時並未普及。

  3. 淪陷政治：北平地方維持會的實際運作與內部關係 / Politics of Occupation: The Operations and Internal Dynamics of the Beiping Security Maintenance Committee
    席卿循 · pp. 103-146
    摘要

    北平地方維持會是「七七事變」後日軍扶植的首個淪陷區政權，具有重要且特殊的意義。本文以北平地方維持會祕書長、北平市社會局長李景銘的日記為線索，結合中日檔案及相關史料，從「行政技術」與「權力關係」的視角出發，探討北平地方維持會的組建經過，以及行政運作中的複雜內情與權力糾葛。可以發現，侵略戰爭、種族對立、政治派系和個人利益等多重因素，共同塑造了維持會內畸形的權力關係，它損害了維持會運作的公正與效率，但也影響了日軍意志的貫徹，同時也在一定程度上為民生喘息提供了可能。對維持會內「行政技術」運作結果的失望，使得部分中方人士對日心態由「親日」轉為「厭日」，這揭示出「合作者」思想和心態起伏變化的新動因。

No. 42 · 2026-06 · 5 篇 · 文化研究學會 · 文化研究 · Peer-reviewed
  1. 天下共生的悖論：何謂「天下」？天下之「餘」在何處？ / The Paradox of Tianxia Co-existence: What Is“All Under Heaven”? Where Lies Its Surplus?
    劉紀蕙 · pp. 9-54
    摘要

    本文提出的問題是：「天下」的視野如何構成了空間秩序？「天下」與「共生」為何存在著不可化約的悖論？「餘」的視角可否作為批判分析的起點？ 本文的基本命題是，「天下」是一個視野的問題，一個既立足於世間、又超越於世間的視野。君臨天下，不同的國君看到了不同的版圖，而隨之征戰，併吞並納入不同邊疆部落的領土，並且以治理技術穩定統治的秩序。「天下」的版圖與邊界的移動，見證了漫長的土地爭奪歷史，以及伴隨著的治理暴力。每一次的邊界遷移，都是具體的殘酷行動。中國史就在漢族擴張收縮以及其他族群相互傾軋之間，在世界史發展的總的傾向之間，展開了其伸縮變化的曲線。「宅茲中國」的「宅」與「中國」，標記著無法化約的死亡地形學。 本文首先透過施密特對於「大地之法」的分析，說明「法」意味著「空間秩序的安排」，必然牽涉了土地佔取、分配與生產的過程，繼而提出中國傳統「天下觀」的視角，不同於施密特所說明的西伐利亞合約的歐洲秩序，卻恰恰說明了「大地之法」土地爭奪原理的啟動機制。 其次，本文藉由趙汀陽的論點，檢討中國的天下秩序如何展開了疆域擴張的動態地形學，思考「天下」視野是在什麼立足點所捕捉？如何勾勒其版圖？如何分配其空間秩序？本文指出，「中國」時時刻刻在變，其實一直不是同樣的「中國」；或者說，「中國」非「一」，中國是複數的，此「一」並非彼「一」。 第三，本文回到歷史，說明「天下」的政治神學如何形成，「宅茲中國」的「宅」如何遷移，以什麼物質條件來執行？版圖變遷的代價是什麼？維護秩序的制度是什麼？為何天下帝國的擴張具有殖民性格？本文檢討趙汀陽、葛兆光、汪暉、杜正勝與許成鋼幾位學者的論點，並指出天下擴張的殖民性格以及物質性部署。天下版圖的變化曲線實際上代表了疆域變遷的殘酷地形圖：「禮」是作為穩定內外上下以及強迫同化的文化秩序策略，而「刑」必然永遠隨著「禮」而出現，並以征戰兵武與教化控制而彰顯勢力範圍。 第四，本文討論21世紀的中國如何以「天下一家」、「和諧共生」等政治修辭，透過「一帶一路」，鋪展其天下版圖，形成了什麼樣的新天下圖景。本文提出的問題是，為何在此數位天下的基層，出現了前現代保甲制度模式的網格化管理。 最後，本文提出明末思想家方以智所思考的「物論」以及「餘」的位置，作為視角轉移，強調相對於「天下」的膨脹擴張視角及其物質性部署，「餘」提供了不同的視角，得以分析「天下」的極限及其所遮蔽的陰暗處，作為思考殖民認識論的批判性分析之起點。

  2. 台灣留學生的烹飪實作與大同電鍋 / The Tatung Rice Cooker and Culinary Practices: Serving Familiar Tastes of Taiwanese International Students
    遲恒昌 · pp. 55-85
    摘要

    本文討論台灣飲食文化研究上較少被注意到的人與物之關係：台灣留學生與電鍋。大同牌電鍋是台灣家庭廚房常見的家電設備，本研究指出，這尋常的炊具物質實則承載重要的社會與文化意義。通過社會實作理論的整合觀點，本文探討台灣留學生的電鍋與日常獨自烹飪實作的組成過程與元素，包括物質的屬性與功能如何提供熟悉的烹飪實作、操作物質所需的技術與知識，以及文化認同與象徵意義如何連結物質。研究透過對曾居住於海外的台灣留學生進行半結構深度訪談，探討他們在海外的大同電鍋烹飪實作經驗。研究發現，在暫時移民與適應新環境的生活脈絡中，電鍋從家庭電器轉變為個人化的烹飪工具。本文並進一步擴展特定炊具物質作為「多於食物」討論的重要面向，指出電鍋既作為個人劃界的媒介，同時也連接了遠方的社會關係與文化認同。

  3. 博物館教育工作者的實踐脈絡及其反思：以臺灣原住民族地方文化館為例 / Museum Educators’Practices and Reflections: A Case Study of Indigenous Cultural Museums in Taiwan
    謝景岳 · pp. 87-122
    摘要

    本文以博物館教育工作者對於教育推廣工作的實踐脈絡為題，臺灣原住民族地方文化館教育推廣工作為例，館員及治理機制中關鍵行動者之經驗與觀點、參與觀察以及文獻所獲資料為分析依據，探究原住民族地方文化館教育功能的實踐動機、形式與意義，以及治理機制對於教育推廣實踐過程的影響因素及其效應。研究發現，館員作為關鍵行動者，其族群文化傳承責任感、迫切感及其對規則與資源的掌握度，皆使其產製具備在地文化特徵與當代需求的教育推廣模式。而政策與行政體系等治理機制雖造成相關工作缺乏文化與族群主體性且位處實踐邊陲，卻也顯示個人能動性與治理結構相互影響之現象。基於上述，本文提出從探索族群文化中學習特徵及其方法，嘗試從族群文化教育走向多元文化教育以及具備博物館功能以外的動能與方法等原文館教育或可發展的方向，同時就原文館政策與博物館教育研究提出建議。

  4. 趨附中的再製與再現：國軍遷臺後音樂文化詮釋初探 / Reproduction and Representation under Ideological Conformity: A Preliminary Study of Military Music Culture after the ROC Government’s Relocation to Taiwan
    黃千珮 · pp. 123-159
    摘要

    軍中音樂主要以軍歌與軍樂兩種形式呈現，構築了人們對軍中音樂的核心記憶。然而，自其生成之初，軍中音樂便具有明顯的功能性，其存在與認同不可避免地隨著人文環境、政治驅動和社會需求的變遷而發生轉向與變異。基於此，本研究透過歷史性的社會觀察，採用「再製、再現」的意識形態國家機器視角，探討軍中音樂作為國軍文化表徵，如何與社會互動並引發質變或形變。文中進一步剖析了軍中音樂隨時代潮流所經歷的演變，這些變革體現於主體與客體之間的持續交錯流動。自抗戰時期起，軍中音樂肩負教育與訓練功能，隨後經歷了國家要求人民遵循國家意識形態的階段，逐漸轉向以「使用者中心」的需求位移。這些轉變描繪了軍中音樂在當代的掙扎、突破與再製歷程，同時記錄了從遷臺、戒嚴、反共、外交受挫到自我修復、解嚴與民主轉型的文化發展軌跡。

  1. 1920年代小組的 非列寧主義淵源── 一個青年政治技術史的分析
    汪正晟
    摘要

    本文從青年政治技術史的角度，探討國民革命期間小組習氣的現象與淵源。小組政治技術並非僅自蘇聯引進，早在以俄為師之前，中國青年就從英美管道接觸到小組實踐；朱光潛則在試驗美國道爾頓制(Dalton Plan)教學法時，寄託了以小組共同生活形塑個人自由研究的理想。不少留蘇中國青年則直接將道爾頓制自主學習的想像，加諸於莫斯科中山大學等幹部學校之上，倒逼中共旅莫支部與校方配合改進。在國共合作下的上海大學小組，即使經過民主集中制的訓練，學生仍帶有自由研究的濃厚小組習氣。小組政治技術，與其說為列寧主義所獨創，不如說是世界性青年政治結構下，引進歐式教育理念的自然結果。

  2. 成乎？渝乎？ 十八世紀四川糧食市場整合再探
    謝美娥
    摘要

    近年清代糧價研究頗有進展，一為單區個案顯著增加，二為市場整合研究大受青睞。單區個案之中，有幾個省經常以其局部府區納入另一更大範圍中分析，而非以完整省區為單位對待，四川是其一。對於四川市場整合的探索，論者最關注的是該省與外省的關聯，其次是主張四川糧食運輸成本對其市場整合有促進作用。至於四川內部，既有論點主張區內呈現高關聯，並於18世紀形成以成都為該區最高層級中心地、唯一核心的市場網絡。如今糧價數據完整，加上施堅雅(G. William Skinner)曾詳研四川各層級中心地的分布，當進一步以四川省區為單位，檢驗以往論點。本文擷取「清代糧價資料庫」中的四川米價進行實證，結果顯示，關於四川糧食市場網絡的核心，學界長期習於認知的既有論點尚須保守以待。

  3. 日軍特務機關在占領區的 日常運作及在地連結── 以海州陸軍特務機關的 《陣中日誌》為中心
    姜子浩
    摘要

    研究抗戰者大多對日軍的「特務機關」略有所聞。軍特務機關是日軍施行占領地統治的重要機構之一。鑒於史料匱乏，學界對其組織運作的實際情況仍所知有限。本文利用數份海州陸軍特務機關的《陣中日誌》，剖析特務機關的內部運作機制以及它干預地方社會的方式。 過去以來，軍特務機關作為情報機構的角色遭受低估。特務機關人員的日常事務中，以地方資訊之收集、整理及傳送為其最主要部份。機關成員透過密集參與各種會議、協商、懇談，或提交調查報告或口頭報告，以協調各軍政經機關的行動，持續「更新」上級機構對駐區的認識，並向轄區內的地方盟友發送指令。日誌實際呈現出特務機關成員，以日為單位維持及加強跨地區的權力及情報網絡。同時，特務機關規模有限，與其所負責的龐雜業務並不相對稱，組織運作長期處於過載狀態，因此不得不將部分任務委由在地代理人執行，而協力政府僅是這些代理人中的一部分。日軍在海州地區運用幫派、武裝地主協助其治理地方，自有其必要性，但此舉無疑亦使地方權力進一步碎片化。「委託─代理」關係的重層化，加大了日軍監察地方政務的難度，無形有利於抗日陣營的滲透與顛覆活動。

  4. 當歸 ──二十世紀上半「女人要藥」的 重製與新研
    李貞德
    摘要

    本文分析當歸在二十世紀上半中國製藥救國論中的位置，以期刊論著和報章廣告為主，政府檔案和藥廠出版為輔進行考察，一窺傳統通用本草在現代中國經歷陌生化和再認識的過程。 當歸調血，自古即為止痛良藥，在宋代確立其婦科地位，至明代更被視為「女人要藥」。但其用處甚廣，醫方常見，乃至有「十方九歸」之稱。唯十九世紀末，德國學者引介當歸，促成默克藥廠產製專利通經藥，販售全球並回銷中國。西潮來襲，中國既面臨知識危機，亦催化國藥改良。有志之士起而迎戰，或建立藥廠、研發製劑，並頻繁運用廣告宣傳。也有醫生檢討傳統炮製之法、專家嘗試辨識當歸原植物種類和功效來源，甚至在中日戰爭的艱困環境下進行臨床試驗。 在此期間，當歸的論述從傳統本草的性味炮製一變而為生物分類與有效成分；當歸的功能則從「十方九歸」的廣效形象聚焦於調經助孕。雖然，學者對分類和成分的討論莫衷一是，但製劑和煎湯並用的百人月病試驗再度確認了古人對當歸調血的識見之明。同時，在父系家族文化和救國人口需求的交互作用下，藥廠頻發的廣告插圖，忽略當歸的多功能傳統，強調其溫宮催孕之功、逐漸將之形塑成健美廣嗣的幸福人生解方。

  5. 評Stephanie Balkwill, The Women Who Ruled China: Buddhism, Multiculturalism, and Governance in the Sixth Century Berkeley: University of California Press, 2024. 260pp.

漢學研究

Vol. 44, No. 1 · 2026-03 · 7 篇 · 國家圖書館漢學研究中心 · 漢學 · Peer-reviewed
  1. 漢初中尉考──以張家山336號墓〈功令〉為中心 / A Study of the Commandant of Capital in Early Han China: Evidence from the“Ordinances on Merit”功令from Tomb 336 at Zhangjiashan
    馬增榮 · pp. 1-44
    摘要

    秦漢官制史的研究，長期以來深受《漢書》〈百官公卿表〉與《續漢書》〈百官志〉所建構之框架影響。在此框架下，學者多強調漢代中尉宿衛京師的職能，或將其作為「三公九卿」之一加以討論。最近公布之張家山336號墓出土〈功令〉，為探討中尉職掌及其於秦漢之際之發展，提供了新的視角。本文指出，本屬武職的中尉，不僅負責選擇罷歸軍吏，供御史大夫與丞相任命之用，亦有權自內史或旁郡屬縣調補佐史於中都官任職，為傳世文獻所未載。然而，漢初中尉之人事權並不完整，其對軍吏無任命之權，調補權亦僅限於佐史一級。考慮漢初多以功臣或其後代出任中尉，此職的制度設計當與其時局勢密切相關。再結合地方上的郡尉、縣尉來看，中央和地方各級尉官均享有一定程度的人事權，頗能反映漢初政府為應對軍事威脅而採取的措施。

  2. 兵屯與更番──1680年代的臺灣駐軍議論 / The Rotating Soldier System and Settlement: Debates on the Qing Dynasty Garrison System in Taiwan in the 1680s
    李文良 · pp. 45-70
    摘要

    臺灣在十七世紀晚期的康熙年間，首度被納編為政權主體在歐亞大陸東部的中華帝國。清領之初面對此一入關後曾長期征戰、具活潑商貿活動之海洋島嶼，在納編版圖、治理經營上曾有諸多的議論，環繞在駐軍政策的「班兵制度」，即為其中的重要課題之一。關於清初在臺施行特殊的「班兵制度」之緣由，目前一般的說法大都認為：清廷為了有效管控臺灣治安必須在臺駐兵，卻又懼怕駐軍在臺據地為王，因此規定不准任用在地土著，而是從福建內地各營抽調部分兵員組成，且「三年更替，謂之班兵」；論及「班兵制度」之創建起源時，則常引用施琅的〈恭陳臺灣棄留疏〉，明白主張或隱約暗示班兵乃是出自施琅的構想。然而，施琅的駐軍主張其實是與強調兵丁定期輪調的「班兵」正好相反的屯墾制度。 本文將利用近年來重刊的清初史料，將班兵與屯田等議論並置，重回十七世紀晚期的整體時空環境，關注駐軍政策和臺灣土地資源爭奪之關聯。我們有興趣的課題，與其說是朝廷的治臺構想或班兵制度的具體施行年代及內容，倒不如說是地方社會在政權轉換之際的狀況，以及站在第一線必須面對社會、承擔治理之責的臺灣地方文武官員之立場和想法，對於清廷駐軍政策和未來臺灣社會形成與發展之影響。

  3. 《皇清職貢圖》所見清朝對回疆地區的認知與書寫 / Representations of the Qing Dynasty Towards Southern Xinjiang as Evidenced by the Qing Illustrations of Tributary Peoples
    曲強 · pp. 71-98
    摘要

    《皇清職貢圖》中有「安西廳哈密」、「肅州金塔寺魯古慶」、「烏什、庫車、阿克蘇等城」三組圖涉及回疆地區。由於哈密和吐魯番歸屬清朝較早，被清朝視作內地，相關畫片一度被劃入陝甘部分。法藏本《皇清職貢圖》中存在「𤞑」、「回」混用現象，可動態體現清朝統一西域過程中對待回人態度的轉變。由於編纂人員對哈密與安西的歷史關係認知不足，導致「安西廳哈密」一圖滿文標題出現重大錯誤，所指群體出現矛盾。清朝統一西域過程中，大小和卓占據喀什噶爾、葉爾羌，負隅頑抗，加之兩地與喀喇沙爾缺乏對清朝的職貢歷史，被排除出《皇清職貢圖》，反映出清朝對回疆各地與其歷史關係和認知的具象呈現。

  4. 信眾語言與宗教地景──桃竹保生大帝、媽祖藥籤的閩客書寫及區域流播 / Faithful Language and Sacred Landscape: Minnan and Hakka Script Practices within Yaoqian Texts and Their Regional Circulation in Temples of the Taoyuan–Hsinchu Region
    陳筱琪 · pp. 99-141
    摘要

    本研究以桃竹地區保生大帝與媽祖宮廟所流傳之藥籤為核心，探討信語言使用與方言書寫對民間醫療實踐與宗教地景形成之影響。藥籤內容中閩南語詞彙的轉寫尤為明顯，如燉補義的動詞tim33（燖），民間常以「沉」、「朕」、「沈」、「烪」、「㶩」等異體字呈現，映現閩南語於當地社群所具之語言優勢與文化表徵功能。相較之下，客語特徵詞彙在桃竹民間藥籤中出現頻率低，方言書寫現象不具系統性。本文援引聯合國教科文組織（UNESCO）所提出之語言活力九大指標，指出閩、客語在桃竹地區被地方社群積極使用，其語言實踐亦透過宮廟網絡與藥籤文本予以體現，從而形成帶有地域語言特色之信仰模式。藥籤譜的流傳並非完全取決於主祀神明，更傾向依據信眾所屬語言群體來選擇與承續特定的籤譜版本，方言分布遂於無形中建構出信仰地景之語言邊界。

  5. 論虛詞反義同詞現象的形成──以「除」與「除非」為例探討 / The Formation of Ambivalent Functional Words: Chu除and Chufei除非
    張麗麗 · pp. 143-195
    摘要

    同一個詞可表兩個相反概念，學界稱為反義同詞現象。一般而言，實詞係因詞義特殊性質或特殊引伸而有反義，然而虛詞意義相對空泛，為何也能發展出反義？此為本研究的核心關懷。本文特挑選「除」與「除非」來探討此議題，因二詞皆可表達排除與限定這兩個相對的概念。文中透過歷史觀察指出，二詞都是先有排除用法，再從之發展出限定用法，「除」這方面演變源於中古漢語時期漢譯佛經中兩種擴展構式，而「除非」這方面演變則始於唐宋時期的省縮構式，二者所增添或省縮的結構都含有對立或否定成分，此為二詞得以發展出反義概念的關鍵因素。文末亦將二詞的演變與「非」進行比較，以突顯二詞演變的特殊性，並解釋其反義同詞現象為何不會造成使用者混淆。

  6. 評武致知（Rens Krijgsman），《《清華大學藏戰國竹簡》研究與英譯6：《鄭武夫人規孺子》諸篇》
    蔡瑩瑩 · pp. 197-205
    摘要

    史家喜言「過去是一異邦」（“the past is a foreign country”）。儘管語言文字大抵相沿，但因時空遙隔，過去仍充滿陌異與驚奇。由此言之，傳世或出土古代文獻，猶如一扇時光之門；隸定釋讀，便是開啟這道異邦大門的鑰匙。那麼，將古代文獻翻譯為另一種語言，可謂鍛造另一把鑰匙，打開另一扇既同且異，通往平行宇宙之門。

臺大歷史學報

No. 77 · 2026-06 · 5 篇 · 國立臺灣大學歷史學系 · 史學 · Peer-reviewed
  1. 日本平安時代的官方讀經與宮廷信仰活動——以季御讀經的成立與轉變為線索 / Official Sutra-Recitation and Court Religious Practice in Japan’s Heian Period: Tracing the Establishment and Transformation of the Seasonal Imperial Sutra-Recitation
    郭珮君 · pp. 1-42
    摘要

    本文以日本平安時代（794–1185）的「季御讀經」為線索，探討官方讀經儀式與宮廷信仰活動之間的互動。以轉讀《大般若經》為核心的季御讀經，根據《延喜式》規範，是為祈求國家安泰，於春秋二季在宮中特定空間舉行的官方讀經儀式。透過對平安時代史料的細緻考察，本文發現此儀式並非靜態不變，而是經歷了一系列轉變。研究顯示，自10世紀以降，季御讀經的儀式逐漸逸出國家的嚴格規範，展現宮廷信仰活動的特徵。主辦權限從天皇獨有，擴展至皇后（中宮）、皇太子（東宮）等不同權力者，儀式主體轉趨多元。其次，從象徵國家權力的大極殿、紫宸殿舉行，轉移至天皇日常起居的清涼殿，甚至宮外的比叡山等宗教場所，顯示儀式空間的延伸及變化。而轉讀經典的擴增更是顯著，在《大般若經》之外，納入了反映個人延壽祈願的《壽命經》。 上述變化不僅反映宮廷內部權力轉向多元的政治現實，亦展現宮廷成員的個人信仰需求如何重塑國家級的儀式框架。因此，季御讀經不僅是官方讀經，也是被靈活應用的儀式實踐，為理解平安時代的政教關係與宮廷信仰文化提供新的切入點。

  2. 巴蘇亞．梅金及其《女學復興論》——作者、文本與觀念 / Bathsua Makin and Her An Essay to Revive the Ancient Education of Gentlewomen (1673): Authorship, Text, and Ideas
    石爍 · pp. 43-101
    摘要

    巴蘇亞．梅金（Bathsua Makin，1600–1681？）是17世紀英格蘭的女性教育思想家，也是英國女性主義的早期先驅。學界一般將梅金的代表作《女學復興論》（An Essay to Revive the Ancient Education of Gentlewomen）認定為她獨創，亦有觀點認為是馬克．劉易斯（Mark Lewis，1600–1681）所作，但按照既有證據推定，這本小冊子係梅金與劉易斯合作完成，梅金負責該書前36頁的內容。這部分內容體現了梅金所傳承的人文主義教育傳統，而非夸美紐斯（John Amos Comenius，1592–1670）派的教育理念。梅金援用這種傳統，為婦女受教權辯護，進而發展出一種早期女性主義思想。尤其值得關注的是，梅金的論著重新思考婦女與重大歷史事件的關係，與今日的婦女史實踐道路不謀而合。並且，她將婦女地位當成衡量國家發展程度的標準，預示了啟蒙時代相關主題的進一步討論。

  3. 集約式工業化農業之起源？19世紀英國高農業與牲畜育肥 / The Origins of Intensive Industrialized Agriculture: High Farming and Livestock Fattening in Nineteenth-Century Britain
    李鑑慧 · pp. 103-171
    摘要

    一般咸認集約式農業出現於二戰之後。然而，本文指出，早在19世紀，英國所推行的「高農業」（high farming）即堪稱其前身。此時，部分英國農場開始以工業化價值為典範，朝向高投資、科學化與機械化運作，以提升效率和產量。在動物飼育方面，也出現室內圈養與高效育肥（high fattening）等標誌性特色。本文以組裝理論，依序分析共構高農業實踐的異質組裝元素，包括啟蒙知識經濟學、商業資本文化、科學技術、物質原料、農舍設計、動物以及人類對於其之生命治理。藉此組裝式理解，本文突顯高農業結構的機遇性組合（contingencies），分析各異質元素交互影響下的發展特色，並探究其變遷。1870年代，高農業各構成元素之不穩定性，以及農業蕭條與國際競爭，使得其組裝暫時瓦解。這脆弱與易變的組裝也說明，今人習以為常的工業化農業並非固著不變，任何構成元素的變動，包括思想與意識形態、全球市場結構、科學技術的發滯、物質資源的豐匱，以及環境與動物倫理思考，都可能牽動結構轉變與解體。

  4. 1960年代臺獨運動者強制遣返與日本的人權運動 / The Forced Repatriation of Taiwanese Independence Activists in the 1960s and Human Rights Movement in Japan
    陳翠蓮 · pp. 173-227
    摘要

    1960年代日本發生多起臺灣政治運動者遭強制遣返事件。其中，1968年柳文卿事件強制遣返過程甚為粗暴，引起日本社會高度關注。此一事件使得日本政府與臺灣威權當局合作、以臺獨犯交換重刑犯強制遣返的暗黑手段公諸於世。 本文目的有二：一、分析日華政府強制遣返臺獨運動者的談判過程，此一政治交易中各自的利益基礎與決策考量。二、從東亞人權史角度，探討臺獨運動者強制遣返事件引發日本公民社會的政治亡命者人權保護運動，以及人權運動的國際連結與擴散效應。 本文發現，戰後臺灣當局為了打壓在日本的臺獨運動，以一名臺獨犯交換三名重刑犯作為條件，希望藉此消滅臺獨運動。此種「長臂管轄」、「跨國鎮壓」模式，正顯示威權政府侵犯基本人權、威懾反對運動的特性。其次，日本作為冷戰結構下東亞僅有的民主國家，是鄰近威權國家南韓、朝鮮、臺灣的反對運動者尋求庇護之所。日本政府與臺灣威權當局合作強制遣返臺獨運動者，嚴重侵犯人權，引起日本輿論強烈反彈，公民社會發動一波波政治亡命者人權保護運動。 柳文卿事件後，臺獨運動者與日本人權運動者攜手，於1970年成立國際赦免組織日本支部，使日本的政治亡命者保護運動與國際人權運動匯流。同時，國際赦免組織日本支部關西地區成員又於1977年另組臺灣政治犯救援會，以組織化、專責化方式，為臺灣政治犯人權強力發聲、訴諸國際社會，造成臺灣威權政府極大壓力。1980年代以前，日本如同亞洲人權運動基地，也間接成為臺灣民主運動推進的可貴助力。

  5. 發舊稿之餘蘊――錢穆宋學著作的「徹底整理」及其學術史意義 / Exploring the Information in Previous Editions: The“Thorough Organization”of Qian Mu’s Works on Song Xue and Its Significance in the History of Academic Studies
    李古月 · pp. 229-265
    摘要

    錢穆（1895–1990）有修訂舊稿後重新出版的習慣，其著作版本情況複雜，尤其體現於宋學相關作品。改動之處透露出他思想上的轉折，惜後人未能充分重視。是故，《錢賓四先生全集》的出版，並不代表錢穆著作「徹底整理」的完成。繼續梳理同一著作不同版本間的異文，是推進「徹底整理」的關鍵，也有助於發展錢穆研究。 本文以版本異文為基礎，勾勒錢穆宋學思想的演變過程，揭示錢穆宋學「宗主」從陽明轉為朱子的原因，以及在轉變過程中具體詮釋上的變化；深入認識錢穆清學史觀點，突破立足於漢宋門戶之爭的研究模式，更全面地理解錢穆對戴震（1724–1777）等人的評價。

臺灣史研究

Vol. 33, No. 2 · 2026-06 · 4 篇 · 中央研究院臺灣史研究所 · 臺灣史 · Peer-reviewed
  1. 在中、日帝國勢力夾縫間的商業韌性：南臺灣大海產雜貨商的崛起（1895-1941） / Commercial Resilience between the Cracks of Chinese and Japanese Imperial Power: The Rise of a Major Merchant of Seafood and Sundry Products in Southern Taiwan (1895-1941)
    林玉茹 · pp. 1-41
    摘要

    本文以長崎泰益號所建構的臺南網絡中，與其交往最久、又是科舉家族弱房出身的王汝禎為研究對象，試圖分析其如何因應中、日帝國政經關係與全球化經濟的劇烈變動，並透過金義興號的營運發展、自身商人地位的變化，以及對現代化經營的積極學習，展現遊走於帝國勢力夾縫之間的殖民地商人韌性。 本文有幾點發現。首先，以出身「科甲之裔」自居，成為王汝禎的文化資本，不僅得以擴展在地臺商網絡，也獲得日商旭商店居中媒介，1910年代成為臺南海產批發行與函館直接貿易的代表性商人。其次，臺灣海產雜貨商雖然最先透過長期控制日本海產出口的神戶和長崎華商進行與日本的直接貿易，然而1910年代已經日本化的臺商，不僅可以直接和日本出口商交易，甚至到神戶設立公司，進一步建構臺南、基隆以及神戶的貿易網絡，也因此降低對在日華商的依賴或在臺日商的競爭優勢。第三，金義興號退出泰益號臺南網絡的原因，一方面是全球及日本帝國圈內進口海產來源多元化，導致對泰益號的需求選擇彈性極高；另一方面，則是長崎航運劣勢和泰益號組織的惰性，而讓該地海產缺乏價格和品質的競爭力。第四，相對於1920年代泰益號進入營業消退期，臺南商人之間建構出來的貿易網絡，以及因應安平港和高雄港的消長，共同合資在高雄港設立從事跨國進出口貿易的利興公司，反而奠定王汝禎作為南臺灣巨商的地位。由此突顯臺商比泰益號更能迎合變動劇烈的時局，呈現跨足華商和日商網絡以及自創臺商網絡的商業韌性。

  2. 張培成推動中華民國一貫道總會成立所面臨的挑戰：以官方檔案為考察核心 / Chang Pei-cheng and the Founding of the ROC Yiguandao (I-Kuan Tao) Headquarters: Challenges Revealed in National Archives
    鍾雲鶯 · pp. 43-85
    摘要

    一貫道在臺灣曾經歷長期的查禁與污名化的過程，一貫道可以合法傳道，就臺灣信仰自由而論，頗具象徵意義。 本文乃透過臺灣國家發展委員會檔案管理局解密的檔案，探討一貫道在臺灣第一代傳道者張培成，以及他創立中華民國一貫道總會過程中所面臨的各種挑戰與壓力。 一貫道內部極重視倫理，張培成在一貫道屬後輩，然而他卻承擔開辦一貫道總會的責任。1959年，他的名字開始出現於官方文件之中，1963年之後，他成為與政府機構往來的主要交涉者。 戒嚴時期，一貫道是否合法取決於國民黨中央黨部，內政部無權決定。面對當時國民黨立法委員的提議，與擔心選票流入民進黨，1987年2月16日，行政院正式宣布解除一貫道傳道禁令。 一貫道總會創辦時期，張培成須面對其他宗教團體的質疑，以及泛一貫道信仰派系的挑戰。經張培成數十年的持續努力，1988年3月，一貫道總會終於成立。

  3. 解嚴初期情治機關的政治考量與「獨臺會案」偵辦始末 / Political Calculations and the“Taiwan Independence Association Case”in Early Post-Martial Law Taiwan: The Making of an Investigation
    吳俊瑩 · pp. 87-141
    摘要

    1991年5月「獨臺會案」反映解嚴初期情治機關在政治考量下的選擇性偵辦：對單純「言論」趨向容忍，但對涉及「組織化」的行動，以《懲治叛亂條例》、《中華民國刑法》第100條加以嚴懲。情治機關並掌握著「言論」與「組織」的模糊解釋權，循低成本鎮壓原則選擇性執法，鎖定陳正然、廖偉程、王秀惠、林銀福（MasaoNikar）等非檯面人物，藉該等的背景及社會關係，向勞工、校園、原運、教會等社運力量示警，迎合行政院長郝柏村不能姑息臺獨的強硬立場，並藉本案遏制臺獨聯盟自美遷臺行動。 本案偵辦關鍵在於情治系統的長期佈建。國家安全局循解嚴前的辦案模式主導情資整合與內線工作方式。法務部調查局以長期打入史明的偵破佈建林榮來（「青山」）為核心取證，掌握交付傳單、印刷《獨臺會革命綱領》與宣誓入會等「著手實行」證據，並與檢方在審理中掩護其身分，調查局事後擬給重獎感謝，「用掉」長期培養的內線，顯示本案非外界所稱烏龍辦案。政治決策上，總統李登輝對偵辦步調事前知情，折射出其在權力平衡與安撫保守派的考量下核可收網行動。 然而，情治機關錯估野百合學運後的社會動能，過度自信，以為掌握足夠證據便能壓制外界質疑，未事前知會清華大學校方即逮捕廖偉程，成為案件失控的破口，引發校園與社會大規模抗爭，促成《懲治叛亂條例》提早廢止。然獨臺會案並非終點，在1992年5月《刑法》第100條修正前，檢調仍持續以預備內亂等罪名偵辦後續臺獨案件。儘管輿論高喊「反政治迫害」，國安局仍將本案視為敵我政治鬥爭，以「依法辦案」自我辯護並推動反制宣傳，顯示其面對臺獨的敵我框架並未鬆動；即使修法後，情治機關的監控與政治操作亦未隨之停止。

  4. 誰來採茶？鹿谷及周邊中高海拔茶區的產業發展（1970-2010s） / Who Picks the Tea? Tea Industry Development in Lugu and Adjacent Mid- to High-Elevation Regions, 1970s-2010s
    曾獻緯 · pp. 143-201
    摘要

    本文以鹿谷與周邊中高海拔的茶區為例，結合官方檔案、比賽評審報告與口述歷史，探討1970年代以來茶農為因應地形、茶園擴張、品質認知及勞動力供給轉型，而調整茶菁採摘的勞動調度機制，形塑地方茶業的生產模式與經營策略，說明手工採摘與產業發展之間的互動關係。隨著茶葉由出口導向轉向內需市場，飲茶風氣日盛，凍頂茶成為高級茶，手工採摘更成為其品質標誌。為因應市場偏好，茶農普遍栽培青心烏龍，致使採收期集中，加劇短期勞動力缺口。在此背景下，茶農選擇手採以維持品質與形象，卻也因茶園擴張與本地勞動力不足，勞力來源從傳統的換工機制轉向外僱採茶班。傳統換工蘊含人際關係所形成的非正式約束與品質規範，有助維持採摘水準；外僱工依斤計酬，為求多摘多得，品質往往良莠不一，易致茶菁受損，使茶農在效率與品質間陷入兩難。本文指出，除了製茶技術與比賽制度外，茶菁的採摘時機、標準與人力調度，亦是左右製程穩定與風味的關鍵。在回應市場期待與應對勞動條件變遷的過程中，茶農展現持續調整的能動性，手採既成為品質保證，卻也成為限制其彈性轉型的結構性制約。本文主張，應跳脫「機械化即取代手工」線性假設，轉而從地形條件、品質規範與市場認知的互動中，理解農民如何在多重限制下所做出的策略選擇。
